stories.title: Sources: O's trade All-Star C Rutschman to BoSox
stories.summary: The Boston Red Sox are acquiring three-time All-Star catcher Adley Rutschman in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs acquiring RHP Holmes from Mets
stories.summary: The Cubs are acquiring right-hander Clay Holmes and outfielder Tyrone Taylor from the Mets for infielder Jefferson Rojas, sources said.

stories.title: Harper to outfield amid Phillies' shuffle for Arraez
stories.summary: Bryce Harper will "ease" back into playing right field to help fix the Phillies' infield conundrum caused by the acquisition of second baseman Luis Arraez.
